title: Add FPS counter to stats display in main.py
details: Draw current FPS in the bottom-right corner stats panel. dev_plan.md testing methodology references an FPS counter in Tab stats, but none exists. Add it to the stats text rendering.
notes: No changes needed: FPS counter already implemented at main.py:1414-1417 (commit 5a87b76, 2026-08-03). Renders 'FPS: {clock.get_fps():.0f}' at bottom-right corner (W - width - 10, H - 24) using font (line 379) and clock (line 377). Task was created from stale dev_plan.md that predated the implementation. Verified via syntax check, import check, and 5s headless sim run with no errors.
